title: Grand Canyon Total Cloud Inversion Timelapse - Jan. 28, 2015
place: Hopi Point, South Rim, Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona
notes: Time-lapse of a sea of clouds completely filling the canyon, with the red rim and buttes poking through under a blue sky. The original's second scene (30-60 s) shows a partial inversion with more canyon visible and could be an alternate. The audio track is digital silence (-91 dB). 1080p. No people, no logos.
fact_en: A rare ground inversion can fill the Grand Canyon from rim to rim with a sea of clouds; ground inversions occur when cold air is trapped by a layer of warm air.
